break_sequence_into_segments: use sequence_to_segments to break a PyTorch tensor sequence into fixed-size segments with optional context padding
reconstruct_sequence_from_segments: use segments_to_sequence to concatenate a list of tensor segments back into a full sequence
generate_padding_mask_from_lengths: use lengths_to_padding_mask to convert a 1-D length tensor into a 2-D binary padding mask
generate_attention_mask_with_context: use lengths_to_attention_mask to generate a left/right context-bounded attention mask from sequence lengths
pad_sequence_with_context: use pad_sequence to add extra left or right context padding to a tensor along a given time axis
